before.name: Coastal aragonite saturation state (Ω)
before.source: Barrett, L.J., Vlahos, P., McGuinness, M.A., Whitney, M.M., Vaudrey, J.M.P. (2024). 'Droughts and deluges: changes in river discharge and the carbonate chemistry of an urbanized temperate estuary.' Frontiers in Marine Science 11:1398087. Table 1 — western Long Island Sound (WLIS) July–September average bottom-water aragonite saturation state.

scoring.worked_math: higher_is_better, scale defaults to |target| = 3. level_pct = (target − value) ⁄ scale × 100 = (3 − 1.09) ⁄ 3 × 100 = 1.91 ⁄ 3 × 100 = +63.7. Positive = overshoot beyond the ecological ceiling: measured Ω is 1.91 units below the Ω≥3 target, i.e. 64% of the way from the target toward Ω=0. Context: Ω 1.09 is only just above the Ω=1 dissolution threshold.
